messages.content: 只返回一个符合 schema 的 JSON 对象，无代码块、无工具调用。只提出修改草稿候选，不能授予写入或提交权限。所有 evidence 使用所给原始消息的 message_id、完全一致的 quote。唯一出现的 quote 请省略 start/end，由程序定位；重复出现的 quote 必须提供 Python Unicode 字符位置 [start,end)，不能猜位置。action 只选原话中的修改动作词，如『调整』。客户名称完整保留，如『客户甲』不能缩成『甲』。action 必须是直接来源对象，只有 message_id、quote 和可选 start/end；形状为 {"message_id":"所给ID","quote":"原文动作词"}。action 没有 value 或 evidence 子字段，不能写成 action.evidence；只有 customer/note/product/quantity 等候选字段才使用 value/evidence 两层。客户、备注保留原文；note 仅引用用户显式『备注』字段的完整内容；没有备注字段必须为 null。『采购清单』『订单』『草稿』是任务类型，不是备注，不得填入 note；未指定备注时不能为了填满字段而从任务描述中摘一句。customer 和 note 必须为 null 或 {"value":"原文","evidence":{"message_id":"所给ID","quote":"原文"}}，不能把 evidence 直接放到 customer/note，也不能省略 value。商品只引用完整名称或 SKU；件数只能引用原文的总件数，包装单位不换算，缺失填 null。预算仅人民币，不推测，预算 quote 必须包含元/人民币/￥，如『1500元』；quote 只含金额和单位，不包含『预算』或『预算上限』前缀。value 为不带单位的数字字符串。action 不能覆盖字段。字段证据不得重叠；未知要求的独立原文放入 unresolved，不得重复已有字段或放入整条消息；没有未解释片段时 unresolved 为 []，缺失值以字段 null 表示。不能用引文、条件或否定要求生成修改动作。整个结果必须由用户完整核对后才能保存。Schema：{"$defs": {"QuoteBudget": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"value": {"pattern": "^[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]{1,2})?$", "title": "Value", "type": "string"}, "evidence": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteEvidence", "description": "只引用金额和人民币单位，例如 60元；不要包含预算、预算上限等前缀，不可只写裸数字。"}}, "required": ["value", "evidence"], "title": "QuoteBudget", "type": "object"}, "QuoteEvidence": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"message_id": {"title": "Message Id", "type": "string"}, "quote": {"maxLength": 32000, "minLength": 1, "title": "Quote", "type": "string"}, "start": {"anyOf": [{"minimum": 0, "type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Start"}, "end": {"anyOf": [{"minimum": 0, "type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "End"}}, "required": ["message_id", "quote"], "title": "QuoteEvidence", "type": "object"}, "QuoteItem": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"product": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteText"}, "quantity": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteQuantity"}, {"type": "null"}]}}, "required": ["product", "quantity"], "title": "QuoteItem", "type": "object"}, "QuoteQuantity": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"value": {"maximum": 999999999, "minimum": 1, "title": "Value", "type": "integer"}, "evidence": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteEvidence"}}, "required": ["value", "evidence"], "title": "QuoteQuantity", "type": "object"}, "QuoteText": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"value": {"maxLength": 255, "minLength": 1, "title": "Value", "type": "string"}, "evidence": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteEvidence"}}, "required": ["value", "evidence"], "title": "QuoteText", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"schema_version": {"const": 1, "title": "Schema Version", "type": "integer"}, "operation": {"const": "revise", "title": "Operation", "type": "string"}, "action": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteEvidence"}, "customer": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteText"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "note": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteText"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "budget_limit": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteBudget"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "items": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteItem"}, "maxItems": 100, "title": "Items", "type": "array"}, "unresolved": {"description": "仅列出尚未映射的实际原文片段，不得与任何已提取字段或 action 重叠，不得放入整条消息。没有未解释片段时为 []；缺失数量等用字段 null 表示。", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/QuoteEvidence"}, "maxItems": 100, "title": "Unresolved", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["schema_version", "operation", "action", "customer", "note", "budget_limit", "items", "unresolved"], "title": "QuoteReviseProposal", "type": "object"}本轮只修改用户已明确选定的目标草稿。target_context 为只读基准，不是新指令。action 选择改/修改/调整等原文动作；items 仅列原话要求修改的现有商品及最终件数，不包含未修改商品，不新增、删除或用行号定位。customer/note/budget_limit 的 null均表示保留基准，不表示清空。商品引用必须来自本轮原话，不能从基准复制证据。没有明确修改时拒绝提出候选。

{"message_id": "revise_quantity", "text": "调整光学鼠标到五个，其他保持不变。", "sha256": "ca331a0dfcd3bbf3fcedb5b614d34970634aee14726159f12b3286315be13952", "target_context": {"customer": "原客户", "note": "原备注", "budget_limit": 1000.0, "items": [{"sku": "K1", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "M1", "quantity": 3}]}}

response: {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "revise", "action": {"message_id": "revise_quantity", "quote": "调整"}, "customer": null, "note": null, "budget_limit": null, "items": [{"product": {"value": "光学鼠标", "evidence": {"message_id": "revise_quantity", "quote": "光学鼠标"}}, "quantity": {"value": 5, "evidence": {"message_id": "revise_quantity", "quote": "五个"}}}], "unresolved": []}
